title: Grand Sikkim & Darjeeling with North Sikkim & Tiger Hill
highlights: Sacred Gurudongmar Lake (17,800 ft) & Yumthang Valley
Indo-China border at Nathula Pass & Tsomgo Lake
Tiger Hill golden sunrise over Mt. Kanchenjunga
Evening walks on Gangtok MG Marg & Darjeeling Chowrasta

days.label: Day 1
days.title: NJP / IXB to Gangtok - Hill Drive & MG Marg
days.text: Pickup from NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport (IXB). Scenic drive along the Teesta River to Gangtok. Check into your hotel and spend the evening enjoying MG Marg.

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Gangtok to Lachen - Waterfalls Trail
days.text: Scenic journey to North Sikkim, stopping at Butterfly Waterfall, Seven Sisters Waterfall, and Chungthang Dam before arriving in high-altitude Lachen.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: Lachen to Gurudongmar Lake & Transfer to Lachung
days.text: Dawn expedition to sacred Gurudongmar Lake at 17,800 ft surrounded by snow peaks. Lunch in Lachen, followed by drive past Bhimnala Waterfall to Lachung.

days.label: Day 4
days.title: Lachung to Yumthang Valley & Return to Gangtok
days.text: Morning exploration of Yumthang Valley (Valley of Flowers). Lunch in Lachung, then scenic drive back to Gangtok for evening relaxation.

days.label: Day 5
days.title: Gangtok to Nathula Pass, Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir
days.text: Day tour to Nathula Pass on the Indo-China border (14,140 ft), glaciated Tsomgo (Changu) Lake, and Baba Harbhajan Singh Memorial Temple.

days.label: Day 6
days.title: Gangtok to Darjeeling - Tea Hills Transfer & City Sightseeing
days.text: Transfer across tea-clad hills from Gangtok to Darjeeling. Afternoon visit to the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, Padmaja Naidu Zoo, and Japanese Peace Pagoda.

days.label: Day 7
days.title: Darjeeling Tiger Hill Sunrise & Drop to NJP / IXB
days.text: Early morning drive to Tiger Hill for sunrise over Mt. Kanchenjunga, visit Batasia Loop, return for breakfast, and transfer to NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport.

included: Dedicated private vehicle (Innova / Xylo) for all 7 days
6 Nights hotel stays (3N Gangtok, 1N Lachen, 1N Lachung, 1N Darjeeling)
All meals in North Sikkim and daily breakfast & dinner in Gangtok and Darjeeling
North Sikkim, Nathula Pass & Tsomgo Lake permits pre-arranged
Pick-up and drop-off at NJP Station / Bagdogra Airport
